title: First meeting Jelly Roll Morton on Basin Street
summary: Garland first met Morton in New Orleans playing piano on Basin Street; the interviewer mentions his earlier tape with Nesuhi Ertegun.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Okay, what about the Jelly Roll Morton, then, now that we're talking about him? Where did you first meet him?
Right here.
What did they call him, then?
Jelly Roll Morton. Okay.
And what was he doing, then, or should I ask?
Playing down on Basin Street.
Uh-huh. Playing cards with the horses, a piano? What?
The professor.
He was a real professor.
Playing in that house.
Oh, yeah?
I think he's playing down at Mimicristines.
Oh, between Conta?
On the basin between Benville and Conta. Oh.
I don't know that place. I remember that.
Heard of it, Captain.
I heard of it from you. On your other tape. On your other tape with Nezue, I think. That's what you made with Nezue. You know, Nezue may come to town.
Yeah?
For the festival. That's what George Wien told me.
Is that right? Well, let's not... I don't know. I wouldn't be surprised to look up and see Nick. No.
You don't know what you're going to find?
Huh?
You don't know when you're going to find him.
He's all over the world. No. He come down to the front of me. I know that.
